meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 说明某个技术时，Claude会按“谁、什么、哪里、为什么、何时”五个角度给出通俗易懂的拆解，把专业内容翻译成大白话。
howto.when: 当用户想对某个技术内容要一个通俗易懂的解释，或说出“这也太专业了”等类似请求时触发。

say.text: 这也太专业了，帮我用大白话讲讲这个技术的来龙去脉。
say.note: Claude会按五个W给出通俗解释。

say.text: 用简单的话解释一下负载均衡，它是谁、做什么、在哪生效、为什么和何时用。
say.note: 适合生成技术术语的通俗版。

say.text: 把“区块链”拆成谁、什么、哪里、为什么、何时讲给我听。
say.note: 直接套用技能的核心句式。

howto.what_en: When asked to explain a technical topic, Claude breaks it down into the who, what, where, why, and when in plain English, making it easy to understand.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical, for example by saying the skill's sample phrase.

say_en.text: This is too technical—explain it in plain language from A to Z.
say_en.note: Claude answers with the five W's.

say_en.text: Explain load balancing simply: who, what, where, why, and when.
Explain blockchain in terms of who, what, where, why, and when.
